Short answer: we prefer an endorsement + COI where possible. Certificate-only sometimes doesn't provide the contractual protection we need (endorsement ties to the policy terms). That said, for small pilots customers sometimes push back.

If they will not provide an endorsement, we can accept an ACORD 25 COI only if it:
- Lists Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors and subsidiaries as "Additional Insured" (or the exact legal entity the Order Form references).
- Shows Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood (if buyer's carrier will provide it).
- Includes policy limits that meet our minimums in the MSA: Auto: $1M, GL: $5M, Tech E&O: $3M (see attached example_endorsement_iso.png).

If endorsement is produced, the recommended wording for Additional Insured endorsement is: 
"Where required by written contract, the insurer shall endorse the policy to name as Additional Insured: Redwood Inference, Inc. and its subsidiaries, agents and affiliates, with respect to liability arising out of the operations performed by or on behalf of the named insured under written contract with Redwood Inference."

For Waiver of Subrogation: "The insurer waives any right of recovery against Redwood Inference, Inc. to the extent permitted by law."

Action items for Kimberly: please get broker contact + ACORD example. Mateo, if procurement will only accept COI, ask for the ACORD to show the endorsement reference or include the ISO endorsement page.

-Aditya
